subject: storytime
title: Fly Guy words
about: A boy catches a fly in a jar to enter in a pet show, and the fly turns out to be far smarter than anyone expected. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the story, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, with him reading the words he practised.

book.author: Tedd Arnold
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A boy and a fly become an unlikely pair of best friends in the first Fly Guy book.

passage.text:
fly guy boy jar
pet bug buzz wings
trash smart catch show
prize hi said friend

cards.note: f-l blend; y at the end says long i, like in my
uy says long i, like in buy: it sounds like g + eye
zz is two letters, one sound: z
ng is one sound; the s says z
t-r blend; sh is one part
s-m blend, then ar says ar
tch is one sound, like ch
sh is one part; ow says long o, like snow
p-r blend; magic e: the e makes i say its name
the i says its name, like in I
